items.text: Arizona RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) has missed two games; Mike LaFleur says he returns to practice Wednesday, Week 8 status undecided. Jacoby Brissett starts.
Arizona's Week 7 inactives included DT Walter Nolen III, S Andrew Wingard, G Jon Gaines II and CB Max Melton; no Week 8 designations yet.

Dallas (short week after Monday night): WR/KR KaVontae Turpin (ribs), LB Dee Winters and OT Drew Shelton were inactive in Week 7; LB Marist Liufau and S P.J. Locke are designated to return from IR. No new injuries from the Eagles game were reported.
